# cb:b461

> A user scoping decision (e.g. 'X is out of scope for this sprint') is recorded as a primitive belief carrying the decision-maker and date. This stops future sessions from re-deriving analysis that was explicitly deprioritized, and stays auditable and supersedable if priorities change.
